# TPC-DS-OBT Q65

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  store_s_store_name,
  item_i_item_desc,
  sc.revenue,
  item_i_current_price,
  item_i_wholesale_cost,
  item_i_brand
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    store_sk,
    AVG(revenue) AS ave
  FROM (
    SELECT
      obt.store_sk,
      obt.item_sk,
      SUM(obt.sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      (
        obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
        AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11
      )
      AND channel = 'store'
    GROUP BY
      obt.store_sk,
      obt.item_sk
  ) AS sa
  GROUP BY
    store_sk
) AS sb
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    obt.store_sk AS store_sk,
    obt.item_sk AS item_sk,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.store_sk,
    obt.item_sk
) AS sc
WHERE
  (
    sb.store_sk = sc.store_sk
    AND sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave
    AND store_s_store_sk = sc.store_sk
    AND item_i_item_sk = sc.item_sk
  )
  AND channel = 'store'
ORDER BY
  store_s_store_name,
  item_i_item_desc
LIMIT 100
```
